t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will always appear in specific pairs but can differ in their positions of left and right. The colour of the gnomes is of importance has gnomes of the colours orange, green, blue and red will lead to a bright forest while the other colours will lead to a dark forest, this will determine which has the most mushrooms and it is up to the player to decide if the bright or the dark forest has the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: When deciding to make a choice on which forest to pick, it is important to note that only the colour of the gnome is important and don't pay attention to the size or shape of their hat. The gnomes will typically appear in the same specific pairs which are orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and finally blue and purple with their position left or right not having any importance. If you choose either the orange, green, red or blue gnomes than this will take you to the bright sunny forest while if you choose either of the brown, pink, yellow or purple gnomes than you will be taken to the dark forest. The forest with the greater mushroom count is determined by either if it is light or dark, and will typically stay at that forest for a number of rounds, so you will need to decide which forest between the dark and bright forest has the highest mushroom count. the forest with the highest mushroom count does change over time so it is important to pay attention to maximize your chances to yeld the highest amount of mushrooms.
